headword: {日雇|ひやと}い{労働者|ろうどうしゃ}
reading: ひやといろうどうしゃ

definitions.explanation: A worker hired on a day-to-day basis rather than under a long-term contract, typically paid at the end of each day's work.

examples.japanese: {日雇|ひやと}い{労働者|ろうどうしゃ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: to work as a day laborer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{日雇|ひやと}い{労働者|ろうどうしゃ}がいた。
examples.english: There were many day laborers at the work site.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不況|ふきょう}→不況：04844_fukyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{日雇|ひやと}い{労働者|ろうどうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つける→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: In a recession, it is hard for day laborers to find work.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{日雇|ひやと}い→日雇い：14965_hiyatoi⟧ ('daily hiring') + ⟦{労働者|ろうどうしゃ}→労働者：23971_roudousha⟧ ('worker'). Refers to workers engaged by the day, common in construction and manual labor.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{日雇|ひやと}い→日雇い：14965_hiyatoi⟧⟦{労働|ろうどう}→労働：03785_roudou⟧: day labor
- ⟦{日雇|ひやと}い→日雇い：14965_hiyatoi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work by the day

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{派遣|はけん}{社員|しゃいん}→派遣社員：18875_hakenshain⟧: dispatch/temp worker — employed through an agency, usually longer term
- ⟦{正社員|せいしゃいん}→正社員：13194_seishain⟧: full-time regular employee — the contrasting status
